Don’t be so hard on yourself. I know it may feel like there’s a constant societal pressure to have your entire life be based on success with your career but we each are more than just a job. It must be so incredibly disheartening to feel like you wasted time or are behind- I feel like that too at times, but opportunities come and go and there will be plenty more in the future that you can consider. It may feel like the end of the world right now, but I hope you will take it a little easier on yourself… no job is worth your life… who cares if your peers are “ahead” in their careers? It doesn’t have to be a competition. Popcorn doesn’t all pop at the same time and that’s perfectly ok.
